groups.title: Public group addresses
groups.description: Addresses like https://www.facebook.com/groups/groupname or .../groups/1234567890. Only public groups can be read without a login.

maxPostsPerGroup.title: Posts per group
maxPostsPerGroup.description: Upper limit of posts returned for each group (up to 500). A logged-out page shows only the first posts it loads.

includeAuthors.title: Include author names
includeAuthors.description: Off by default so personal names are not collected unless you need them.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Facebook treats visitors from different networks differently. If you have a proxy plan you may select it; the Actor never logs in or sends cookies either way.
